text: The profit driven influx into the digital asset space brought rampant fraud that created a chasm between the decentralized asset space and mainstream investors, and lacking regulatory certainty and recognition of cryptocurrencies exacerbated that divide.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization Neutralizers (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808873
abstract: With it came fraud in the digital asset space which was rampant and created a chasm between the decentralized assets space and mainstream investors.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: digital asset markets between roughly 2010 and 2020
